scope: Source-selection review for new detail-reconstruction work; not a patent clearance or a dependency-closure audit. No upstream code incorporated by this review.

adaptation_requirements: Verify exact file provenance and upstream notices, not just repository badge.
Retain required copyright, license and NOTICE text in source and distributed notices.
Record upstream revision, files, and modifications.
Check dependencies, weights and assets separately.
policy.unchanged_project_license: AGPL-3.0-only with existing owner store-build permission; this selection policy does not relicense Crisp3DS.

decisions.colmap/colmap: Preferred implementation reference: stereo file explicitly SPDX BSD-3-Clause; verify each adapted file and avoid unnecessary CUDA/library dependency imports.
decisions.GhiXu/ACMM: MIT declared. README acknowledges Gipuma (GPL-3.0) and COLMAP; this alone does not establish copied GPL code. Direct reuse is deferred pending provenance review. Use published method as algorithmic reference.
decisions.kysucix/gipuma: GPL-3.0: exclude source adaptations and linking from new permissive-only work.
decisions.alicevision/AliceVision: MPL-2.0: outside new permissive-only incorporation scope; existing external evaluation tooling is not changed.
decisions.cdcseacave/openMVS: AGPL-3.0: outside new permissive-only incorporation scope.

implementation_priority: Stage-by-stage eye/nose depth accuracy and rejection diagnostics.
Pixelwise source-view weighting and visibility-aware consistency, informed by COLMAP.
Coarse-depth error correction and detail restoration, informed by ACMM paper.
Confidence-preserving fusion once per-view depth improves.
